content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility varies slightly according to the Technician Grade II post and trade. Candidates must possess the required educational qualification, relevant vocational certificate and prescribed work experience. The required two years of experience must be relevant to the concerned trade and should be obtained after acquiring the prescribed qualification. The notification permits experience certificates from Government, Semi-Government, Limited, Private Limited, registered private companies or registered firms, as applicable. For direct recruitment to the advertised Group C posts, candidates must satisfy the eligibility conditions prescribed by the Uttarakhand Government. The notification states that applicable candidates should fulfil the required Uttarakhand employment registration, domicile/permanent residence or educational conditions prescribed for direct recruitment. Among the conditions mentioned in the notification are registration with an employment office located in Uttarakhand up to the last date of application, holding an Uttarakhand domicile/permanent residence certificate, or having passed the prescribed school-level examinations from recognized institutions situated in Uttarakhand, as applicable under the rules. Additional provisions are given for certain Government employees, employees of specified State bodies and their eligible family members. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact condition applicable to their case. The Technician Grade II posts are described as non-gazetted and permanent posts with EPF benefits.

High School or equivalent examination from a recognized Board with Science and Mathematics, All India/State Vocational Certificate in Electrician or Electronics trade, and 2 years of relevant post-qualification work experience

High School or equivalent examination from a recognized Board with Science and Mathematics, All India/State Vocational Certificate in Fitter trade, and 2 years of relevant post-qualification work experience

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for UKSSSC Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026 will be based primarily on an offline written competitive examination. Candidates who fail to obtain the prescribed minimum marks will not be treated as qualified in the written examination. The notification states that the examination will use an OMR answer sheet. Candidates should carefully follow all OMR instructions. Use of whitener or scratching/cutting of options is prohibited and may attract negative marking or other action as prescribed. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the written competitive examination. Where two or more candidates obtain equal marks, preference will first be determined according to age, with the older candidate placed higher. Further tie-breaking will be carried out according to the rules stated in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. What is UKSSSC Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive conducted by the Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission for Electrical and Mechanical Technician Grade II posts under PTCUL and UJVNL.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UKSSSC Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 78 vacancies have been advertised.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UKSSSC Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. When will the UKSSSC Technician Grade II application start?
faq.answer: The online application process will start on 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for UKSSSC Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed High School or an equivalent examination with Science and Mathematics and possess the prescribed vocational certificate in Electrician, Electronics or Fitter trade, depending on the post. Two years of relevant post-qualification experience is also required.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for UKSSSC Technician Grade II?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 42 years as on 01 July 2026. Applicable age relaxation will be provided according to Uttarakhand Government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for UKSSSC Technician Grade II?
faq.answer: The notified pay scale is Rs.27,200 to Rs.86,100 under Pay Level-4.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application fee for UKSSSC Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs.300 for Unreserved and Uttarakhand OBC candidates. Uttarakhand SC, ST, EWS and PwD candidates have to pay Rs.150. Orphan candidates are exempt from the fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for UKSSSC Technician Grade II?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on an offline objective-type written competitive examination, followed by the applicable document verification and appointment formalities.

faq.question: Q10. Is there negative marking in the UKSSSC Technician Grade II exam?
faq.answer: Yes. One-fourth of the marks assigned to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer.
